summary_en: Annual dividend raised to ¥58/share from ¥57/share. Interim dividend ¥29 (up from ¥28), year-end dividend ¥29 (unchanged). FY3/27 full-year net income forecast raised to ¥10.0B from ¥9.2B; EPS raised to ¥153.32 from ¥139.68.
title_en: Notice of Revision to FY3/27 Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: DaikyoNishikawa Corporation revised its FY3/27 dividend forecast upward on 6 August 2026. The annual dividend per share is increased to ¥58 from the previously forecast ¥57. The interim (second-quarter) dividend is raised to ¥29 from ¥28, while the year-end dividend remains at ¥29. The company simultaneously upgraded its FY3/27 full-year consolidated net income forecast to ¥10.0 billion from ¥9.2 billion, and raised earnings per share guidance to ¥153.32 from ¥139.68. The revision reflects stronger-than-expected first-quarter results, higher customer production volumes, increased accessory sales, and positive foreign exchange translation effects, which offset headwinds from elevated raw material costs driven by Middle East geopolitical conditions.
